entities.name: Claude-Frédéric t'Serclaes Count of Tilly
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Field Marshal Claude Frederic t'Serclaes, Count of Tilly was a Dutch States Army officer who served in the Franco-Dutch War, Nine Years' War and the War of the Spanish Succession. A brave and capable cavalry general, in 1708 he became the de facto supreme commander of the Dutch army and led the Allied forces together with the Duke of Marlborough and Eugene of Savoy.

entities.summary: Field Marshal Claude Frederic t'Serclaes, Count of Tilly was a Dutch States Army officer who served in the Franco-Dutch War, Nine Years' War and the War of the Spanish Succession. A brave and capable cavalry general, in 1708 he became the de facto supreme commander of the Dutch army and led the Allied forces together with the Duke of Marlborough and Eugene of Savoy.
